violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. -Raw burgers stored above steak tips in cold hold drawers below cook line.--Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. In 2 door glass cooler: -Sealed package of ground meat stored on wire shelf near top of unit commingling with/and above ready to eat foods. -Flat of whole shell raw eggs stored on wire shelf above ready to eat foods.

Cooling of potentially hazardous food. — --Cooked potentially hazardous food was not cooled properly from 140F to 70F or below within two hours. -Small portion of taco meat was removed from warmer at approximately 2pm and found tightly covered in bottom of make table at 4:30pm with temperature of 90-105F. *Staff disposed of product.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Several portion bags of sliced deli meat in 2 door glass cooler were not date marked for date pulled from freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Black residue at top edge of interior panel of ice machine.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Heavy residue/debris at top surface of dish washer. -Residue at equipment handles throughout kitchen. -Debris at lower shelves next to grill top and next to fryer. -Some dust/debris at walk in cooler fans. -Some crumb debris at bottom interior of 3 door stainless freezer.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical ware washing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. -Dishwasher found with 0ppm chlorine and would not "prime". *Corrected to 50-100ppm Chlorine while on-site: Owner replaced bucket of low chemical, cut off pinched portion at bottom of tube and replaced soft tubing at top feed.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item * was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Case of plastic food storage bags on floor near ice machine. -Case of paper towels on floor in back room dry storage. -Sleeves of Styrofoam cups stored in open box on floor in back room dry storage area.--Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Aluminum pans are not inverted or covered at top shelf in back room dry storage area

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -Bacon stored in drawers above drawers of bagged breads (visible bacon pieces in bottom draw with bread). -Flat of raw, whole shell eggs stored on top of prep table on top of containers of Deli meat and condiments.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Residue at handles of 2 door glass cooler. -Steam well has lime scale at interior and food splatter at exterior surfaces. -Splatter at interior surfaces and handles of microwave. -Residue at exterior surface of containers of pancake powder and breading flour. -Dust/debris at walk in cooler fans.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Grease residue build up at hood vent above griddle and at back surface of hood surround.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -Ran out of Chlorine test strips, stated they should be getting some in today.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Case of single use lids stored on floor in back room--Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Spoons at self serve ice cream station are not all faced one direction.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Build up of grease debris at walls behind cook line. -Splatter/residue at walls behind steam well and pizza ovens.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not maintained in good repair. -Floors have worn paint and grease residue throughout kitchen. -Walk in cooler floors are damaged and rusty throughout.
